transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. We need to get moving on reviewing the vendor's draft agreement for the AI customer-support platform. As you all know, we're targeting rollout next quarter, so we need to move efficiently. Let's start by hearing from each of you on where you stand with your review of the vendor's standard provisions.

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical privacy issue. While reviewing the proposed data flows against our privacy inventory, I confirmed that the platform will process identifiable customer call transcripts. Our approved data-processing standard therefore requires three specific contractual provisions that have not yet been entered into the contract redline: (1) deletion of all customer data within exactly 7 calendar days after termination, (2) an explicit prohibition on use of customer content for model training or service improvement, and (3) processing exclusively within the European Union. These points are missing from the vendor's current draft and must be added before I can submit a formal privacy finding.
